reasoning_content:
pnpm install completed successfully. Note that "node 24.15.0" was added as a devDependency (the node package).

Next, since the scripts were ignored, I need to manually copy the web-ifc wasm file as in setup.sh:
```
cp node_modules/web-ifc/web-ifc.wasm web/public/web-ifc/web-ifc.wasm
cp node_modules/web-ifc/web-ifc-mt.wasm web/public/web-ifc/web-ifc-mt.wasm
cp node_modules/web-ifc/web-ifc-node.wasm web/public/web-ifc/web-ifc-node.wasm
```

After that:
1. cp .env.defaults .env + adjustments
2. pnpm prisma generate
3. pnpm setupDb
4. pnpm prisma migrate reset
5. pnpm codegen
6. pnpm dev (start the dev server and verify on localhost:3000)

First I'll do the wasm copy and the .env setup.
